ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious PowerShell Invocations - Specific - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious PowerShell invocation command parameters Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo

sequences.query: ((ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-nop.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\[Convert\\]\\:\\:FromBase64String.*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-noni.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-nop.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*iex.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\ \\-w\\ .*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-ep.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*bypass.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-Enc.*")) OR ((ContextInfo = RGX(".*powershell.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*reg.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*add.*")) AND (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\run.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\wow6432node\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\run.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\\software\\\\microsoft\\\\windows\\\\currentversion\\\\policies\\\\explorer\\\\run.*"))) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*bypass.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-noprofile.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\-windowstyle.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*hidden.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*new\\-object.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*system\\\.net\\\.webclient.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\.download.*")) OR (ContextInfo = RGX(".*iex.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*New\\-Object.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*Net\\\.WebClient.*") AND ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\\.Download.*"))) AND  NOT ((ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\(New\\-Object\\ System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient\\)\\\.DownloadString\\(\\'https\\:\\/\\/community\\\.chocolatey\\\.org\\/install\\\.ps1.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*Write\\-ChocolateyWarning.*")))
